correctness.rationale: For alpha0=top and alpha_{j+1}=Box Diamond alpha_j in arbitrary finite K-frames, set N_j=not alpha_j and P_j={x:R(x) subset N_j}. Direct semantics gives N_{j+1}=pre(P_j). Minimal i+j argument proves N_i disjoint P_j; monotone sequences ensure their successive layers disjoint. Any alpha_m not alpha_{m+1} world induces successively nonempty N_1..N_{m+1} and P_0..P_m first-entry layers, forcing at least 2m+2 vertices. A directed path of 2m+2 with terminal dead end supplies sharpness. At equality layers are singleton a_i,b_j, and first-entry rules uniquely force b0 dead, bj->aj and optional earlier a, ai->b_(i-1), no earlier b, optional all a and later b. There are exactly 2m+1 forced edges and E_m=(m+1)^2+m(m+1)/2+m(m-1)/2=2m²+2m+1 independent optional edges. Intrinsic layers fix every vertex, implying rigidity; unique separating a_(m+1), unlabelled 2^E, labelled (2m+2)! 2^E and edge polynomial (2m+2)! z^(2m+1)(1+z)^E. Independent bitmask scan of all four-world relations confirms 768 four-world separators/192 rooted; all-m proof is structural, not finite extrapolation.
